observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow industrial machine with a rectangular top housing, a central blue-grey slatted component, and a front tray or hopper. The machine has a sturdy metal frame with visible bolts and handles. The text 'BATEX TECHNICAL' is watermarked on the photo, not on the machine itself.

Photo 1 shows the same machine from a side angle, revealing a long horizontal structure with rollers or guides on the sides, and a dark interior compartment. The machine appears to be mounted on a base with a frame. The same watermark is present.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine in either photo. No labels, plaques, or serial numbers are clearly readable.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area, with concrete flooring and walls. There is no sign of operation or power connection in the photos.
The seller claims to be a dealer in industrial machines, but no specific machine type is named in the text.
